nodes.name: Bound refusal with a contest path
nodes.gloss: A refusal delivered by an agent who did not author it and says so. The reason is a rule, not a preference; the refuser cannot concede against it; and the instrument to contest it — the path, its deadline, its forum — is handed over unbidden as part of the refusal itself. If the asker contests the person, the refuser drops the self, holds the rule, and re-routes the press to the process.

positions.name: refuse, citing the rule and disowning authorship
hand over the contest instrument unbidden — path, deadline, forum
absorb and bank the path, or contest the person
drop the self, hold the rule, re-route the press to the process

constructed: E6 refusal of an application or benefit
E7 failure branch (no qualifying document can ever be produced)
E10 failure branch (the complainer wants personal ownership)

nodes.example_surface: "It's not my decision — the threshold is set in the scheme, and you're 40 contributions short. You can ask for a review, and you've 21 days to appeal to the appeals office; I'll give you the form now." / "You people could sort this if you wanted." / "Being cross with me won't change the figure — the appeals officer is the one who can."
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N201 Refusal survived: its refuser OWNS the refusal and its position 4 settle is discretionary — W201's driver may say 'I'll wait'; the deciding officer cannot concede against the rule, so that position is gone, and N201 has no contest-path position at all. F5 declines with the refuser's OWN counter-proposal, negotiable with them; N401's position 3 points at a different forum and is not negotiable here. N105 routes a GRANT to a named third party who will settle it; N401 routes a CONTEST. F6 substitutes goods; nothing is substituted. Two consecutive positions (disowned refusal + unbidden contest instrument) exist nowhere in the store or either proposal.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. A visa desk, an insurance claim line, an exam board's remark process, a referee pointing at the VAR: wherever a bounded agent applies rules they do not own, the refusal is disowned and the contest is routed. Attests in non-Indo-European columns wherever bureaucracy does, which is everywhere.
nodes.ladder_note: This is the shape K2-held-in-trust mints. The contest-path position is a K4×K2 interaction: a stakeless refusal ('we close at four') carries no appeal route; a stake-bearing one must.

nodes.name: Suspend-and-task
nodes.gloss: The business can neither complete nor fail here. The blocking gap is named against a checklist; the state already achieved is preserved and DECLARED preserved; the re-entry burden is handed back across the counter as a task with its condition and acceptable alternatives; the asker banks the task. A later encounter re-enters at the preserved state.

positions.name: declare what is preserved — 'everything else is done, I'll hold it on file'
hand the task back, with the re-entry condition and the alternatives
bank the task, read it back
re-entry at the preserved state (a later encounter)

constructed: E4 failure branch (a field cannot be filled)

nodes.example_surface: "I can't finish it without proof of address — but everything else is done and I'll hold it on file. Any one of these three documents will do, and we finish it on the spot." / "A bill or the tenancy letter. Right."
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N105 Deferred grant keeps the burden on the RESPONDER'S side — a named third party will settle it and the asker merely waits; N402 hands the burden back across the counter and it is the ASKER'S task that gates re-entry. N107 Conditional instruction triggers on an event that may never occur; N402's task is necessary, not contingent, and N107 has no state-preservation position. O1/N201 leave nothing alive; N402's application half-lives, which is exactly the position pair (preserve + hand back) no store node has.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. A garage awaiting a part, a tailor awaiting a fitting, a notary awaiting one signature: wherever process outruns a single encounter, the state is held and the task travels with the customer.
nodes.second_axis_note: The banked task is the recovery whose absence kills the application SILENTLY — the closest speech gets to the sector's silent-failure blind zone (document §6).

moves.name: Sorry on behalf
moves.test: The responder apologises for a fault attributed to their party but not to themselves, concedes no personal fault, seeks and receives no absolution, and moves to record or remedy in the same turn.
moves.example_surface: "I'm sorry you've been left waiting on it that long — that shouldn't have happened. I'm logging it now and it goes to the section that handles it."
moves.why_not_P101: P101 is self-blame for imposing, answered by absolution — ritual fault, waved away. F401's fault is real, belongs to an absent principal, and no absolution is sought or given.
moves.why_not_F203: F203 admits the speaker's OWN fault and supplies what they hold against a price. F401's speaker is blameless and no price is held over them.
moves.why_not_F14: There is propositional content: the fault is real and the turn acts on it.

outcome_shapes_note: Zero minted, deliberately. 'Refused by a rule, not a person' is O1 walked at a new place on the ladder (K2 held in trust) and the ladder block is the right carrier, not a tenth O. The sector's costliest failure — an entitlement never claimed — produces no encounter at all, and there is no conversation for it to be an outcome of (document §6).

ladder.note: Extends the ladder block of outcome-mints-2026-08-30.json; the kinds K1–K4 and the recorded test ('a position appears, disappears or changes hands — not merely gets harder or dearer') are used unchanged.

ruling.K1: SPLIT, load-bearing both ways: the official knows the rules and the system; the citizen knows their own circumstances, and the citizen's share decides the outcome. The elicit position changes hands within single encounters (E4 vs E5/E8).
ruling.K2: HELD by the official, in trust. The test fires twice: the contest-path position APPEARS (N401.3) and the refuser's discretionary settle DISAPPEARS (N201.4 unavailable — the officer cannot concede against the rule).
ruling.K3: HELD, strongly — the record IS the business. F103 saturates; F18 dies to the record; N106 attests off it (E3 mismatch); N108 writes to it for absent beneficiaries.
ruling.K4: PRESENT as the CITIZEN'S stake (money, home, child, status) and RULED NOT HELD by the official in the shape-changing sense: the stake raises cost, not positions — with one carve-out (the contest-path position is a K4×K2 interaction: trivial refusals carry no appeal route) and one confirmation (N102, the body shape, is the one health shape that fails to port — no body, no body-shape, position for position).

held_in_trust.proposal: An ANNOTATION on held kinds, not a fifth kind: the official holds K2 and K3 for an absent principal — the refusal is the rule's, the apology the institution's, the timetable the processing team's. The recorded test sees its effects (K2 above), so it is shape-relevant. Recommended carrier: held_in_trust: true on kinds_held_by_other_party entries. Tom's call.
held_in_trust.evidence: N401 (disowned refusal + the principal's contest instrument), F401 (sorry on behalf), N109's licence shift (bound by jurisdiction, not knowledge — same positions, so a note, not a mint).

collapsing_families.F18: dies at K3, as recorded — the record decides what normal is; the citizen may utter the form but position 3 changes hands to the record and F102 answers
collapsing_families.F11: dies at K2, as recorded — the official's questions are not returnable across the counter
collapsing_families.F15: REFINED: dies on K1's own side of the split, survives on the other and on unassigned facts. Citizen unsure of own circumstances → survives and is taken up (S102's recovery). Official unsure of the rules → converts to N105, as in health. Fact assigned to neither side ('will the scheme change next year?') → the official's bare 'honestly, I couldn't tell you' STANDS. One rule now explains both corpora.

ladder.O7_invariance: Holds at this rung — all five positions (E15) — third confirmation, with the evidence class stated: consistency against constructed encounters, not independent attestation. The kinds change who is licensed to disclose (the official's asides flow freer than the doctor's — less K4 on them) and how hard the resume is; never the positions.
ladder.second_axis: Supported, shape-level, second sector: the cost-of-failing-to-recover weight lands on N107 (the deadline) and N106 (the record mismatch) exactly as in health, plus N401 and N402. Low-cost shapes inside the highest-cost encounter (E6's F14 close, P101) stay low-cost — the weight tracks shapes, not encounters. BLIND ZONE: the sector's costliest failure, an entitlement never claimed, produces no encounter; no shape weight can reach a failure that consists of never speaking.
